pricing.title: Choose Your Learning Plan
pricing.subtitle: Flexible plans designed for every learner — from exploring single islands to full platform access.
pricing.plan1Desc: Full platform access — all subjects, all islands
pricing.plan2Desc: Focus on one subject at a time
pricing.plan3Desc: One-time purchase of a single island
pricing.plan4Desc: Personalized learning with a live teacher
pricing.faq1Answer: Yes. You can cancel your subscription at any time. Access continues until the end of the billing period.
pricing.faq2Answer: Absolutely. With the full subscription you can switch between subjects at any time. Single subject plans can be upgraded.
pricing.faq3Answer: Yes. Each island is purchased individually as a one-time payment. You can buy as many as you like.
pricing.faq4Answer: Private lessons are 1-on-1 sessions with a qualified teacher. You choose the time and subject. Sessions are 60 minutes.
pricing.faq5Answer: Yes. All subscription plans include parent dashboard access so you can track your child' s progress.
